map.买房时算得房率判断公摊大小。: Work out the usable rate when buying to judge the shared area.

map.建面 100㎡、使用 82㎡ → 得房率 82%（优秀 s5）；面宽 10、进深: Gross area 100 sqm, usable 82 sqm gives a usable rate of 82% (excellent, s5); width 10 and depth 12 give a depth-to-width ratio of 1.2 (fairly regular, s4): composite = 5 × 0.5 + 4 × 0.5 = 4.5, excellent.
map.若使用仅 65㎡、得房率 65%（偏低 s2）、进深面宽比 2.0（偏长 s3）: With usable area of only 65 sqm the usable rate is 65% (low, s2) and a depth-to-width ratio of 2.0 (elongated, s3): composite = 2 × 0.5 + 3 × 0.5 = 2.5, poor, so avoid it.
map.得房率多少算优秀？: What usable rate counts as excellent?
map.≥80% 优秀、75%–80% 良好、<70% 偏低；高层普遍低于多层。: 80% or more is excellent, 75%-80% good and below 70% low; high-rises generally run below low-rises.
map.进深面宽比怎么算？: How is the depth-to-width ratio calculated?
map.=进深÷面宽，1.0–1.5 方正采光好，>2.2 狭长中部暗，<0.7 偏宽可: = depth ÷ width; 1.0-1.5 is regular with good daylight, above 2.2 is elongated with a dark middle, and below 0.7 is over-wide and can produce narrow, long rooms.
map.得房率 = 使用面积 ÷ 建筑面积 × 100%，含公摊的高层住宅一般在 70%: Usable rate = usable area ÷ gross floor area × 100%; high-rise housing with shared area usually falls between 70% and 80%
map.方正度以「进深 ÷ 面宽」比值衡量，1.0–1.5 采光通风均衡为佳: Regularity is measured as depth ÷ width; 1.0-1.5 balances daylight and ventilation best
map.输入数据应为同一户型、同一计量口径，避免混用套内与建筑面积: Inputs should be for the same unit on the same measurement basis; do not mix inner area with gross floor area
